## Security and data safety

- [ ] No tokens, credentials, raw personal artwork, unauthorized references or private paths in commits/CI artifacts
- [ ] No unreviewed network calls, reference uploads or paid model API usage
- [ ] If Bridge/file/native behavior changed: command allowlist, path boundaries, explicit approval and ambiguous-effect handling reviewed
- [ ] Tests use disposable input and do not overwrite actual user work
- [ ] Source/asset/license provenance documented where relevant
- [ ] README English + Chinese updated together if features/API/install/status changed

## Review notes

Relevant evidence, safety limitations, open questions and any reviewer decisions needed. **Do not merge automatically without maintainer approval.**
